Title: Model Context Protocol Specification (Revision 2024-11-05)
Normative_Security_Summary: Initial public specification release (JSON-RPC 2.0 host-client-server architecture, stdio and HTTP+SSE transports, sampling introduced; no normative authorization profile).

Title: Model Context Protocol Specification (Revision 2025-03-26)
Normative_Security_Summary: Added optional OAuth 2.1 authorization profile for HTTP transports, RFC 8414 authorization server metadata, PKCE for public clients, RFC 7591 dynamic client registration SHOULD recommendation, and Streamable HTTP transport.

Title: Model Context Protocol Specification (Revision 2025-06-18)
Normative_Security_Summary: Defined MCP server formally as OAuth 2.0 Resource Server; mandated RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata and RFC 8707 resource indicators (audience-bound tokens); prohibited token passthrough; required per-client consent for static-ID OAuth proxies.

Title: Model Context Protocol Specification (Revision 2025-11-25)
Normative_Security_Summary: Added OpenID Connect Discovery interoperability, incremental scope consent via WWW-Authenticate, recommended Client ID Metadata Documents, and introduced client consent requirements for local server installation.

Title: Model Context Protocol Specification (Revision 2026-07-28)
Normative_Security_Summary: Latest specification revision evaluated: mandated RFC 9207 issuer validation, deprecated dynamic client registration in favor of Client ID Metadata Documents, transitioned to stateless per-request framing (removing protocol-level sessions and initialize handshake), and deprecated Sampling, Roots, and Logging.
